identifierProjection.entitySHA: Hash of urlsplit(href-or-url).path only; excludes origin, query and fragment

identifierProjection.note: Hashes are pseudonymous linkage fields, not evidence of anonymity against a party that already knows the source identifiers.

evidenceClasses.collectorObservations: Supplied safe JSON preserves what the collector recorded; geometry/style/date values are not independently recollected live.
evidenceClasses.recomputed: Sort parsing/buckets/comparisons, style-chain checks and panel rectangle ratios recomputed from supplied JSON.
evidenceClasses.exactCrops: Nine exact decoded RGB pixel crops from the six authorized screenshots, checked against capture SHA-256 and saved as PNG. Source screenshots decode as JPEG despite .png names. Bounds and capture-to-DOM links are in crop-provenance.json.
evidenceClasses.priorPixelAnalysis: Mobile and three-width numerical files are byte-identical analyst reports. The original JPEG was not opened, copied or independently verified during packet preparation.
evidenceClasses.attestations: Deployment reports, supported source download, retained transient tool/console excerpt, and recovered screenshot interpretation are collector/parent attestations, clearly labeled.
evidenceClasses.staticSource: Supplied immutable source references explain intended behavior but do not prove served identity.

independentPublicVerification: A publisher can verify file hashes, sanitized row calculations, style/geometry derivations and visible crop contents. With only this public packet, they cannot independently verify original raw source-image bytes, private screenshot-to-crop pixel equality, live DOM collection, retained unsaved tool results, or deployment state.
